t: What he said while they were carrying bricks
a: وَيْحَ عَمَّارٍ تَقْتُلُهُ الْفِئَةُ الْبَاغِيَةُ، يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ، وَيَدْعُونَهُ إِلَى النَّارِ
p: Wayḥa ʿAmmār, taqtuluhu-l-fiʾatu-l-bāghiyah, yadʿūhum ilā-l-jannah wa yadʿūnahu ilā-n-nār
m: Alas for ʿAmmar. The transgressing party will kill him. He calls them to the Garden and they call him to the Fire.
